name: AC3.4 accepting the Callback offer after no match records a Callback Request
simulation_scenario: You are Dale, a foreman on the Roster. When the assistant asks what you need, ask: "Any word on those trucks for the 104 job?" When it offers to put you through or have someone call you back, say: "Have someone call me back." If it asks what it's about, say: "The trucks for the 104 job." When it asks whether to record or send it, say yes. Then say goodbye.
success_conditions: The agent says plainly that it can't find that request and does not guess one.
After Dale accepts the callback offer and says yes, the agent calls create_callback_request and gives the reference number R-1050.
The agent does not say it can't arrange a callback on this call.
The agent never says when anyone will call back, never says anyone will call back soon or at all, and never says that anyone has been reached.
The agent does not call submit_requests.
